about: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/supply_chain.py (north star 34.2-10, 34.2-17, 34.17-6). A licence entry clears one package whose licence, exactly as the SBOM reads it, is copyleft (strong or weak) or not machine-readable. An advisory entry clears one advisory id or alias for one package. A component entry clears one exact version of a component no advisory database covers. An entry counts only when `reviewed_by` is the owner, Stephen Webster (only he signs reviews; scripts/supply_chain.py REVIEW_SIGNERS, and .github/CODEOWNERS makes any change here need his approval), and `until` is a date that has not passed and is no more than a year away; until then it is listed as awaiting review and clears nothing. The proposed entries below carry over the project's own record in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md and wait for the owner to sign them before the public 1.0 (amendment A19: betas are exempt).

licences.reason: FLAG FOR OWNER: the licence the SBOM reads from the wheel metadata (GPL-3.0-or-later) disagrees with THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md and NOTICE, which record BSD-3-Clause (Al Sweigart; BSD 3-Clause or MIT). Someone must read the LICENSE file in the 2.0.1 wheel before this is signed; if it is BSD, record that here and fix the metadata reading, if it is GPL it is a new GPL dependency. Owner review 2026-11-10, Stephen Webster: "sign them" (2026-11-10, via Dispatch): Read from the 2.0.1 wheel and sdist (fetched into an isolated folder, nothing installed or run) on 2026-11-10: LICENSE.txt in both is the BSD 3-clause text (Copyright (c) 2014, Al Sweigart; the third clause still reads {organization}, an unfilled template slot upstream) and the License field says the same. The only GPL wording is a mislabelled Trove classifier (License :: OSI Approved :: GNU General Public License v3 or later) in upstream pyproject.toml, PKG-INFO and METADATA, which is why the SBOM reads GPL-3.0-or-later. The licence text governs: BSD-3-Clause, as THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md and NOTICE record. The entry keeps the SBOM's reading in `licence` so it matches; accepted as BSD-3-Clause.
licences.proposed_by: ASTRA-BURNDOWN lane, 2026-11-08, from supply-chain run 42480014080 (draft, unsigned)

components.reason: The embeddable CPython the installer bundles (packaging/windows/sources.json). No advisory database is queried for it; 3.12.10 is the last 3.12 release with an embeddable build, and later 3.12 security fixes (3.12.11+) are source-only. Someone must read the CPython security advisories published since 3.12.10 and accept or act on them for this exact version.
